description: A lightweight film-editing user interface with OpenAI integration for natural language editing instructions

userStories.title: Save projects to localStorage
userStories.description: As a user, I want my projects to be saved to localStorage so they persist across page refreshes
acceptanceCriteria: When user clicks Upload button with a project name, the project is saved to localStorage
Saved project includes project name and timestamp
Projects are stored as a JSON array in localStorage under 'opn-projects' key

userStories.title: Display saved projects list
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my saved projects in the Projects panel so I can access them later
acceptanceCriteria: Projects panel shows list of saved projects from localStorage
Each project displays its name and creation date
Empty state message shown when no projects exist

userStories.title: Load project on click
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click on a saved project to load it
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking on a project name loads that project
Project name field is populated with selected project's name
Visual indicator shows which project is currently selected

userStories.title: Delete saved projects
userStories.description: As a user, I want to delete saved projects I no longer need
acceptanceCriteria: Each project in the list has a delete button
Clicking delete removes the project from localStorage
Projects list updates immediately after deletion

userStories.title: Form validation for project creation
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear feedback when creating projects with missing information
acceptanceCriteria: Upload button validates project name is not empty
Error message displayed if project name is missing
Success message displayed when project is saved

qualityChecks.notes: This is a static HTML project without TypeScript or test framework
